name: selenium-rust-skill
summary: A Claude Code skill teaching how to write Selenium-style WebDriver browser automation code in Rust with the thirtyfour crate.
description: Teaches locating elements, performing actions, explicit waits, and writing real assertions with the thirtyfour WebDriver crate in Rust — Selenium itself has no official Rust binding, thirtyfour speaks the same WebDriver protocol — grounded in real working examples from this project's sibling demo repos.
